verified_mechanics.predictor: Linear-GELU-Linear-GELU-Linear, biasless, width rounded to a multiple of 128 with projection factor 1.6
verified_mechanics.latent_loss: element-mean SmoothL1 against detached future hidden state
verified_mechanics.kl: teacher future-state distribution to predicted-state student distribution
verified_mechanics.head_path: detached LM-head weight for auxiliary teacher and student

rita_adaptations.mask: canonical residue-to-residue transitions only; PAD and EOS excluded
rita_adaptations.backbone_training: rank-32 attention LoRA instead of the upstream full GPT backbone
rita_adaptations.autograd_optimization: one graph-preserving RITA forward instead of detached leaves plus manual VJP
